title: What eats the plants around your colony
question: Is this the thing you saw when you reported that absorbing destroys plants - a circle chewed back to bare ground like B? And was the speed dial up at the time?
context_md:
Same world, same seed, same 3000 player ticks, speed x8, one circle. The ONLY difference is whether a colony is standing in it.

I could not reproduce your report from the `F` key. Pressing `F` leaves the world **bit-identical** - every plant material, every organism, every death cause, every unit of plant eaten - measured at speed 1 and speed 8 and with 32 ants. The energy motes never touch the world; they are painted into the finished frame.

What does eat the garden is **ants grazing inside a circle, multiplied by the speed dial**. Absorbing is upstream of that rather than the cause of it: it buys the power that keeps the circle standing, and you have to be standing in the colony to press `F` at all.

If B is not what you saw, tell me what was on screen instead - I would rather know my reproduction is wrong than ship a fix for it.

items.label: A - no colony
items.caption: the same circle with nothing living in it

items.label: B - 33 ants
items.caption: a colony founded at the player's feet
